## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0143 D5 加一条记录：`manage_connector_connections` 的默认持有者是平台管理员和两个组织管理员权限集（`organization_admin`，以及经派生得到的 `organization_admin_no_bypass`），其余岗位只能显式授予。
- 为什么改：卡 #28427 第 4 项要求把裁决 B 记进 ADR。代码已由 #28441 落地（8e874038），本 PR 只补这条决策记录，让读 ADR 的人看到默认持有者。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档 4 行，不改任何代码路径，记录的是已落地的行为。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0143-outbound-connector-auth-is-open-tier.md` 的 D5 节新增的一条。
- 两分钟验证：打开该文件 D5 节，读新增的那一条，应与 #28441 的默认授予一致。
- 需要你做的：os-zhuang 审批本 PR（Tier H），之后席位落地。

## What changes

ADR-0143 D5 already said who may connect is "a capability check the server slice declares". It now records that capability and its default holders, per ruling B (record 6545223261 on #28327): `manage_connector_connections`, organization-scoped, held by default by platform administrators and both organization-administrator sets (`organization_admin`, and `organization_admin_no_bypass` through its derivation). Every other position holds it only by explicit grant. The behaviour shipped in #28441 (squash 8e874038); this line is its record.

## Acceptance notes

- Split from #28441 so that PR was not held as Tier H, as the card allows. This PR closes the card.
- No changeset: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
- The branch is the card thread's platform-assigned branch. After #28441's squash merge the remote branch was gone; this head merges `origin/main` into the old tip and adds one commit, so the diff against `main` is the ADR file alone.
